responsive-matrix.about: Residual closeout R13: the FIX04 200-cell responsive matrix (ui/scripts/dev/fix04-product-review.mjs) as a release gate. Each cell runs real assertions on the real local Service: no horizontal overflow, exactly one visible H1, no comparison chip overlap, no clipped status text, no monospaced identifier split mid-token, no keyboard-unreachable scroll container, axe WCAG 2.1 A/AA (aria-hidden [data-ornament] excluded, as in every accepted suite), no page error, no request outside the app origin, visible focus on the Overview's first twelve Tab stops, and the History table's keyboard scroll at 768 and 1024.
